entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_first_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_first_01

entries.text: 藍莓聯盟辛苦囉。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_01

entries.text: 多虧冠軍換了人當，\n原本緊張的氣氛變輕鬆啦！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_02

entries.text: 阿若我老實說啊～\n我也想和烏栗開心地相處……[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_03

entries.text: ……但現實總是沒辦法像\n想像中一樣順利哩～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_04

entries.text: 不要緊！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 總有一天！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 不愧是現任冠軍！\n很會說話喔！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_05

entries.text: ……但事情弄得好像\n我利用了死黨[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一樣。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_06

entries.text: 我是沒有那個意思的，\n不過當下我也變得有點太認真了。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_07

entries.text: 關於這件事，\n讓我重新跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳道歉一次吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_08

entries.text: 身為我們的聯盟社社長！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳今天也在加油嗎～？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_01

entries.text: 社長！？
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 什麼意思？
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 哎呀呀？我沒跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳說嗎？\n聯盟社的社長，\c\n是由藍莓聯盟的冠軍擔任唷。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_02

entries.text: 我現在才知道！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_select_03

entries.text: 我沒聽說過
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_select_04

entries.text: 那真是失禮了！\n總之就是這麼一回事！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_03

entries.text: 別擔心，別擔心！\n大家都會幫[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_04

entries.text: 在我是全校最強的時候，\n我也故意不要冠軍的稱號。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_05

entries.text: 那時是四天王的大家\n輪流負責當社長的喔！\r\n……因為太麻煩了嘛。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_06

entries.text: 要是有什麼事的話，我會幫[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳扛的。\n社長[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就大搖大～擺地當社長吧～！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_07

entries.text: 嘿～死黨。\n上次我跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳說的當社長的那件事……[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_00

entries.text: 「把事情通通丟給[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n 我覺得那是不好的！」[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_01

entries.text: ……我被紫竽那傢伙\n這樣狠狠地訓了一頓。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_02

entries.text: 連以前偷懶的份也被拿出來算帳，\n結果變成我要當社長了……[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_03

entries.text: 加油！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 恭喜！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 恕我直言，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]呀！\n阿若我老實說啊～是根本不想加油！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_04

entries.text: 哦哦！？死黨，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳意外地很敢說嘛。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_04b

entries.text: 啊～好麻煩啊～\n超麻煩的啊～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳想幫忙的時候，\n隨時來把我的工作拿走吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_06

entries.text: 說起來，社長的工作裡\n還包含要協助社員，對吧？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_00

entries.text: 那種小事的話，\n我倒是可以稍微做一點～！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_01

entries.text: 話不多說，我馬上來協助！\n我們來交換寶可夢吧～！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_02

entries.text: 很海派喔～！\n我當然選鋁鋼龍！\r\n死黨[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要選哪一隻？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]啊，選得好！
不愧是冠軍的寶可夢！\c
我雖然怕麻煩，
但我會好～好照顧這傢伙的。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_04

entries.text: 死黨[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要用[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n來跟我的鋁鋼龍交換是吧？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_02_00

entries.text: 初訓家不是自己的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_02_01

entries.text: 稀有的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_02_02

entries.text: 異色的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_02_03

entries.text:
啊～死黨[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳該不會現在
只有１隻同行的寶可夢吧？\c
沒有２隻以上的寶可夢的話，
是沒辦法交換的喔。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_03_00

entries.text: 別這麼說啊～\n可以吧！？協助一下嘛！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_03_01

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳願意協助我了嗎！？\n那我們來交換寶可夢吧～！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_04_00

entries.text: 哦，死黨，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要和我對戰嗎？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_talkto_00

entries.text: 拒絕也不是件壞事。\n隨時都全力以赴的話，可會累的。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_cancel_00

entries.text: 那好，我們準備去對戰場吧。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battlestart_00

entries.text: 哎呀，死黨！\n我想和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳打的是雙打對戰啊。\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳再多帶１隻寶可夢來吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battlestart_01

entries.text: 和死黨[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳交手，\n真是痛快翻天啦～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 為表示平時對[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的感謝！\n我有禮物要送給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 這東西都擺到積灰塵了，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就收下吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 嘿嘿嘿，\n上衣和我的一樣喔～\r\n這就是所謂的死黨裝吧！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]從杜若那裡\n得到了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]運動服套裝（黑×金）[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_reward_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳又～變強了，\n真不愧是我的死黨！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 如果不常常和\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳交手的話呀～\r\n我都變得沒辦法發洩壓力了！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
嘿嘿嘿！
讓我撿到勝利囉。\c
就算[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳輸得不甘心，
也別像烏栗那樣走火入魔啊。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一定以為
我腰上的是裙子吧～？\c
才不是呢～嘿嘿嘿～！
我圍的其實是斗篷喔。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
我不擅長坐著聽那些理論課～
所以留級留了……大概３次？\c
我比其他傢伙享受了更久的學園生活，
真是賺到了～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
椅子是個好東西吧。
真是個讓人感激的發明。\c
站著明明會累，
為什麼大家都要站著？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
我和死黨[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]
相處得可好了～\c
我把牠當作是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳在照顧，
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就放心吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_03

entries.text: 我的鋁鋼龍要是身體亮晶晶的，\n就會很開心。\c\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳偶爾幫牠把身體擦到發亮吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_04
